XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS PWA — Web Push subscription storage (Phase B.2) + delivery log (Phase B.3.c)

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_push_subs
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase B.2 (2026-05-20) — One row per (user, browser) push subscription. Created when the user clicks 'Enable notifications' on /local/sentientia_pwa/ and the browser returns a PushSubscription from navigator.serviceWorker. Deleted when the user unsubscribes OR when push delivery fails 5 times in a row (410 Gone / 404 indicates the browser tossed the subscription).
Endpoint, p256dh, and auth are exactly what the PushSubscription.toJSON() returns. Sender uses them to encrypt the AES-GCM payload before POSTing to the push service URL.
Multi-customer scope: each row carries customerid so future per-customer dashboards can show 'X subscriptions across N tenants' for one customer.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: tenantid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA). Derived from user open_path at insert time.

FIELD.NAME: endpoint
FIELD.COMMENT: The browser's push service URL — fcm.googleapis.com / updates.push.services.mozilla.com / web.push.apple.com etc.

FIELD.NAME: endpoint_hash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 hex of endpoint. Used as the unique index key — full endpoint is too long to index efficiently on MariaDB.

FIELD.NAME: p256dh
FIELD.COMMENT: ECDH public key (base64url) from PushSubscription.getKey('p256dh')

FIELD.NAME: auth_secret
FIELD.COMMENT: Auth secret (base64url) from PushSubscription.getKey('auth')

FIELD.NAME: user_agent
FIELD.COMMENT: navigator.userAgent at subscribe time. Diagnostic only.

FIELD.NAME: last_seen
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of last successful push delivery (NULL = never)

FIELD.NAME: fail_count
FIELD.COMMENT: Consecutive delivery failures. Row is purged at 5.

KEY.NAME: uk_user_endpoint
KEY.COMMENT: A user re-subscribing in the same browser reuses the same row.

INDEX.NAME: idx_last_seen
INDEX.COMMENT: Stale-subscription cleanup query (last_seen older than N days)

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_push_log
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase B.3.c (2026-05-21) — One row per push delivery attempt. Written by push_sender::deliver_one() after every POST to a push service, success or failure. The admin viewer (/local/sentientia_pwa/admin/push_log.php) reads this for operational visibility.
Retention: rows older than retention_days (admin setting, default 90) are purged by a daily cron. Compliance — the log contains no message bodies (only first 200 chars of body, truncated) so it can be retained longer than typical audit logs without GDPR exposure.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Recipient user ID

FIELD.NAME: sub_id
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_push_subs.id. NULL if the sub was deleted between send and log write.

FIELD.NAME: endpoint_host
FIELD.COMMENT: Just the host part of the endpoint URL (e.g. fcm.googleapis.com). For grouping in the viewer.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Push title as delivered (mirrors notification UI)

FIELD.NAME: body_truncated
FIELD.COMMENT: First 200 chars of the body. Truncated to limit PII surface.

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: Click-through URL

FIELD.NAME: tag
FIELD.COMMENT: Collapse tag (correlate with reminder buckets)

FIELD.NAME: http_code
FIELD.COMMENT: HTTP response from the push service (201/204/410/etc). NULL on network failure.

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: 'sent' / 'failed' / 'gone' / 'flag_off' / 'truncated'

FIELD.NAME: error_detail
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional debug message — exception or curl error

FIELD.NAME: sent_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when this row was written

INDEX.NAME: idx_result_sent_at
INDEX.COMMENT: Admin viewer: filter by result then order by recency
